title: Тайный гость в отеле «Элеон»  (The Secret Guest at Hotel Eleon)

scenes.title: Ресторан при бутик-отеле «Элеон»  (A Restaurant Inside Boutique Hotel Eleon)
scenes.summary: Denis explains the three big rules of working at Restaurant Victor inside Boutique Hotel Eleon: early breakfasts, hotel guests, and room service.

scenes.title: Утренние завтраки и тайный гость  (Morning Breakfasts and the Secret Guest)
scenes.summary: During the 6 a.m. breakfast rush, Mikhail warns Chef Barinov that a secret hotel inspector will check in soon.

scenes.title: Жалоба на холод в номере  (Complaint About the Cold Room)
scenes.summary: Vika warns Barinov that the secret guest arrives today or tomorrow, while guests in room 205 complain about the freezing cold.

scenes.title: Бессонная ночь и приход хозяйки  (A Sleepless Night and the Owner's Arrival)
scenes.summary: Katya apologizes to Denis for yesterday's breakup before hotel owner Eleonora Andreevna arrives for her first staff meeting.

scenes.title: Строгая речь Элеоноры Андреевны  (Eleonora Andreevna's Strict Speech)
scenes.summary: Eleonora calls yesterday's grand opening a total failure, demands strict discipline, and asks where the head chef is.

scenes.title: Пожарная тревога в номере 205  (Fire Alarm in Room 205)
scenes.summary: To get back at Mikhail, Chef Barinov lights a fire in cold room 205, setting off the hotel's fire alarm during Eleonora's meeting.

scenes.title: Устное соглашение сторон  (Oral Agreement of the Parties)
scenes.summary: Denis confesses to Kostya that he slept with another girl after Katya broke up with him, and Kostya argues it was legally permissible.

scenes.title: Опасный вопрос Кости для Насти  (Kostya's Dangerous Question for Nastya)
scenes.summary: To prove his point to Denis, Kostya asks Nastya a 'hypothetical' question about cheating after a breakup—and Nastya immediately suspects him.

scenes.title: Соус демиглас и тридцать восемь часов  (Demi-Glace Sauce and Thirty-Eight Hours)
scenes.summary: WhileChef Barinov tends to his prized 38-hour French demi-glace sauce, Mikhail sends a room-service order to distract him.

scenes.title: Испорченный соус и подозрительный постоялец  (The Ruined Sauce and the Suspicious Guest)
scenes.summary: Mikhail ruins Barinov's 38-hour demi-glace in revenge, and Vika stops their brawl by pointing to a guest in glasses as the secret inspector.

scenes.title: Номер люкс для мнимого ревизора  (A Luxury Suite for the Supposed Inspector)
scenes.summary: Mikhail upgrades the bewildered guest to a luxury suite while Barinov personally serves him in the room—and Vika admits she made it up.

scenes.title: Капризы гостя и видеопризнание Дениса  (The Guest's Whims and Denis's Video Confession)
scenes.summary: While the guest in room 313 orders steaks, salads, and new curtains, Denis records a video confession on Katya's phone.

scenes.title: Ночь Кости на полу  (Kostya's Night on the Floor)
scenes.summary: Denis tells Kostya he confessed to Katya, right as Kostya reveals Nastya made him sleep on the floor and warns never to tell women anything.

scenes.title: Щедрые чаевые и капризы с мясом  (Generous Tips and Meat Complaints)
scenes.summary: Waiters fight over huge tips from room 202 while the guest in 313 sends back Chef Barinov's steak and demands freshly ground coffee.

scenes.title: Разоблачение обмана и план Дениса  (Exposing the Trick and Denis's Plan)
scenes.summary: Mikhail and Barinov overhear that the guest in 313 is not an inspector at all, while Denis begs Kostya to distract Katya so he can delete the video.

scenes.title: Охота за телефоном Кати  (Hunting for Katya's Phone)
scenes.summary: Kostya clumsily distracts Katya with culinary riddles while Denis searches for her white phone and finally asks to borrow it.

scenes.title: Месть лжеревизору  (Payback for the Fake Inspector)
scenes.summary: Believing the guest in 313 is a freeloader, Chef Barinov and Mikhail barge into his suite with buckets of coffee and food.

scenes.title: Настоящий проверяющий у Элеоноры  (The Real Inspector with Eleonora)
scenes.summary: The soaked guest storms into Eleonora's office—turning out to be the real secret inspector after all!

scenes.title: Мама Кати — Элеонора Андреевна  (Katya's Mother Is Eleonora Andreevna)
scenes.summary: After Eleonora fines Mikhail and Barinov a month's salary, Katya walks in and introduces Denis to her mother—Eleonora Andreevna!
